entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call is important to us. Please hold for the next available agent.
Hi, you're through to VeloFit, my name is Alex. How can I help you today?
Oh, hello. I... I ordered a jersey and it just arrived, but I'm looking at the return page on your website and I'm just so confused by it all.
I can definitely help clear things up for you. To start, could you tell me what specifically is the issue with the jersey? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference issue?

It's the sizing. The website was a bit confusing and I think I ordered the wrong size. This one is way too tight and I feel like I need to exchange it. Can't you just help me? I don't understand all these steps online.

Of course, I can absolutely handle this for you right now, no need to worry about the website. Getting the perfect fit is key. Since your jersey arrived just a couple of days ago, you're well within our 90-day policy for an exchange.
Oh, 90 days? That's a relief. So you can help me with the exchange?

Yes. I see here that you're one of our VIP members, so I'd be happy to make this extra smooth. I'll email you a prepaid return label immediately. And as soon as you drop the original jersey in the mail, I'll have the correct size sent out with complimentary two-day shipping. How does that sound?
Wow, really? You can do that? That's so much easier. Thank you so much, Alex! I was getting so overwhelmed.
It's my pleasure. I'm glad I could help. I'm processing that for you now. You should see the email with the return label in the next five minutes. Is there anything else I can assist with today?
No, that's perfect. Thank you again!
You're very welcome. Have a great day and enjoy your new gear once it arrives!
